goal: Replace ThesisDocument with ForgeDocument across the renderer-neutral semantic pipeline while preserving deterministic behavior and architecture boundaries.
non_goals: Do not rename the Python distribution, CLI, protocol, frontend, Tauri package, or templates in this slice.
Do not change Markdown syntax, numbering, bibliography policy, RenderPlan shape, or OOXML behavior.
Do not preserve ThesisDocument as an alias.
expected_evidence: Parser and downstream focused regression output
Task report, spec review, and quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A passing parser smoke test does not prove all downstream type consumers migrated.
General and academic projects must produce equivalent semantic structures for identical Markdown.
Core purity must be inspected through tests and imports, not naming alone.
stop_condition: Stop if the slice creates a second domain model, adds compatibility exports, changes semantic behavior without specification, or crosses a forbidden dependency boundary.
